name: Phillip Wilkinson
bio:
Phillip Wilkinson is a highly skilled tattoo artist who specialized in neotraditional and black&gray styles. His intricate and well-formed designs, along with his proficiency in black work, has admirably demonstrated under the alias @blvkphillip, and through the Chester @_crownofthorns studio. The quality and exquisiteness of his work can also be further reflected through his associations with widely recognized industry names such as @killerinktattoo, @hustlebutterdeluxe, and @pepax.official.
